Hi Naomi,

Great to hear from you — welcome, and congrats on the activation. Short answers below and I've attached our canonical CSV AND a one-page guide.

1) Ingestion path: portal webhook is preferred (faster routing & automated ACKs). Secondary: SMTP to payments@acmetools.com is supported as a fallback. If using SMTP, please use subject prefix: [ACME-PAY] followed by Redwood Entity ID and PO number (example: "[ACME-PAY] RDW-2 PO-2026-54321"). That helps us avoid manual triage.

2) Payment Entity: yes — our sample includes a "payment_entity_id" column. We recommend sending that column; otherwise include it in the subject token (e.g., RDW-2) as above. Our ingestion prefers explicit column mapping.

3) PO handling: we accept PO at header level and also support line-level PO references. For automated matching, include a header field named "po_number" (single canonical PO) and optional line_item_po for per-line granularity.

Sample format highlights (see acme_sample_template.csv):
- Required header columns: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, payment_entity_id, po_number
- Line rows: item_description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, tax_amount
- File encoding: UTF-8, comma-separated CSV; max 10MB per file

Attachments: acme_sample_template.csv, Acme-Invoice-Guide.pdf (linkable).

NOTE: When using SMTP fallback, include an invoice PDF attachment with the matching invoice_number (for compliance). If you need SFTP instead, we can provision earlier in the onboarding.

Happy to walk through this on a short call tomorrow morning PST if helpful.

Best,
Sarah Lee
